themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often acting as intelligent pair programmers.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI-powered conversational agents.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or benchmark different AI tools and their performance for specific tasks.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, required skills, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications directly supporting creative and investigative processes in design and user research.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user representations for testing, simulation, and data generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and extract key insights.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to gather, analyze, and derive actionable understanding from customer data and behavior.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
